quote: Except as provided in subsection 3, a person shall not drive a motorcycle, moped or trimobile abreast of or overtake or pass another vehicle within the same traffic lane. Motorcycles and mopeds may, with the consent of the drivers, be operated no more than two abreast in a single traffic lane.

activation.condition: A qualifying motorcycle, moped or trimobile is driven abreast of, overtakes or passes another vehicle in the same traffic lane.

obligation.description: Do not ride abreast of or overtake or pass another vehicle in the same traffic lane except the express two-abreast permission or subsection 3.

exceptions.description: Subsection 3 operative text and applicability require separate original review.

exceptions.source_clause: Motorcycles and mopeds may, with the consent of the drivers, be operated no more than two abreast in a single traffic lane.
exceptions.description: Independent driver consent and actual vehicle count and classification are required.

timing.description: Measure original frame/time history of lane occupancy, lateral and longitudinal position across the full pass or abreast episode.
